summary: Completed frontend testing of FREA! game - Party Mode card, Starlite Shop, buying system, trophy showcase, and Zen improvements

ui_bugs.issue: Cancel button has overlay interception - requires force click

passed_tests: Party Mode card is taller (210px) with background photo (has-photo class)
All mode cards show new webp images (classic, race, survival, tag, hns, hoops, zen, koth, lava, stars, redlight, freeze)
Starlite Shop opens via Shop button (ltop-shop) and Starlites pill (ltop-coins)
All shop tabs render correctly (cosmetics, arenas, themes, furniture, earn)
Cosmetics buying works - balance decreases by 300, item shows 'Owned'
Character Studio opens with locked items showing lock badges
Unlock confirm dialog appears when clicking locked items
Randomize button works in Character Studio
Arena buying and equipping works - Candy arena shows 'Equipped'
Theme buying and equipping works - data-frea-theme='sunset' applied
Trophy showcase in-game profile with 3 slots (showcase-slot-0, 1, 2)
Trophy showcase 'View all' opens trophy tab
Zen Sandbox: Worlds dropdown (#zen-env, #zen-env-menu) properly hidden
Zen Edit Mode: Toolbar appears with all buttons (undo, snap, add, done)
action_item_for_main_agent: Minor: Fix overlay interception on shop unlock confirm cancel button. Optional: Test arena background changes in actual matches, furniture storage system, and trophy pinning functionality. Parent app profile couldn't load due to missing backend, but trophy data is correctly published to localStorage.
